messages:
mira: Heads up - seeing tail latency regressions on host for short streaming calls after the kernel auto-rollout last night. p50 unchanged but p99 doubled.
leo: Can you paste the raw trace? short vs long requests breakdown?
mira: Quick paste from 30s capture:
```
# sample flame (cpu)
parse_chunk_stream        31.2%
tokenize_utf8             22.7%
kv_cache_lookup           9.5%
grpc_recv_hook            6.8%
sys_writev                5.1%
other                     24.7%
```
```
mira: Notable: kv_hit rate drops for these sessions (60% vs 84% baseline), and a lot of tiny writev syscalls when streaming frames <512B.
anya: Are we sure kernel selector is the root? Could be RPC framing overhead interacting with batching heuristics.
leo: Selector currently uses arithmetic mean(seq_len) of microbatch to pick kernel family. When a single long request joins a batch of shorts mean skews up.
taylor: That explains why many short requests fall back to the long-seq slow codepath + repeated KV lookups. Median would be more robust.
mira: I ran a quick A/B: forcing median-based kernel pick reduced p99 from 210ms -> 98ms in the repro cluster for short-heavy mix. p50 stayed ~18ms.
anya: Nice. What about streaming chunking?
mira: Streaming chunker flushes per frame which creates many small writes and breaks KV continuity. If chunker coalesces up to 2KB or preserves KV context across frames, hit-rates improve. In snapshot, evictions spiked: ~150/sec.
leo: Action plan for canary:
- kernel selector: switch to median(seq_lengths) with a config flag + telemetry
- streaming chunker: coalesce small frames up to 2KB before emit
- rpc layer: aggregate writev calls where possible; instrument writev count per request
- add a trace tag: kernel_choice + kv_hit for 20k requests in canary
taylor: I'll add the writev instrumentation into the proxy and emit histograms.
anya: I'll own KV telemetry and add an alert if kv_hit < 70% for more than 2m on a host.
mira: I opened PR 8039 with median selector toggle + unit tests and added repro instructions: ./ci/replayer --mix=shorts-heavy --qps=300 --streaming=on.
leo: I'll prototype chunker coalesce patch and push a small canary image.
devops-bot: Canary perf-run: short-stream-cancel (canary tag) - baseline p99=200ms, canary (median-sel): p99=110ms, canary (median+coalesce): p99=72ms. Full logs at https://ci.redwood/pers/8039/logs
mira: Great numbers. After we ship, consider exposing kernel bias config per-customer so enterprise low-latency tenants can pin a fast-path.
leo: Also adding a microbenchmark to catch selector regressions: runtime/tests/bench_kernel_select.cc with randomized mixes.
taylor: Sync up 09:30 PT tomorrow to roll the proxy coalesce and flip median flag for canary. Owners: mira (repro + PR), leo (chunker + canary image), anya (kv alerts), taylor (proxy writev instrumentation).
mira: Linking flamegraphs + perf diffs in PR 8039. If anyone sees odd regressions ping me @mira. :raised_hands:
